title: Unit Event — The First Concerto — Episode3 Pride

meta.Event Outline: The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD each contend with the missions Ken has assigned them, with their sights on the day they surpass RAD WEEKEND. Toya's task is to write every track they're going to use for their event, and he attempts to pour everything into a song, but that's easier said than done...

rows.Line: Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This part needs to have more presence...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's supposed to be a reflection of what we felt when we first saw or learned about RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Phew...
I managed to put together one song.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, let's try hearing it from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It's not bad...
I've captured the feelings I was hoping to.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But it's still missing a few things...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (All of the songs in RAD WEEKEND made us so excited.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(We all felt a fire light up inside of us...
I remember that vividly.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But this song doesn't cause any of that to happen.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It lacks depth...
Nothing about it makes my heart race.
It's incomplete in that sense.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (After getting help from Soma with composing, I thought I'd come to understand how to imbue music with powerful feelings to create a powerful sound...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But where do I go from here...?
I could try to fix what I already have...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I shouldn't bother...
This song won't help surpass RAD WEEKEND anyway.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I need to start over.
One week later

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've made songs using a few different approaches since then...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But none feel right.
They're all missing that spark.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Why is that...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Am I really up to this task...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If my first song is going this poorly, then what does it mean for the rest?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, don't say that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ken believes that I can do this.
So, I need to figure out what's wrong.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father's Voice
rows.Line: I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(He's coming home later than usual...
No, he said he has a performance at a concert hall coming up.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which means he must be very busy preparing for it. He even said that he'd be playing some of his own songs, so he may've been working on...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (What would he think of my song...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He's both a professional musician and composer. There's a chance that he may be able to point out the issues with this song—)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Dad still doesn't really approve of street music. He may not even be willing to listen to it...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Also, given its quality, I'm not sure if he should hear it...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(No...
I should still ask despite the odds.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Beggars can't be choosers.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Dad, I know you just got home, but do you have a minute to talk?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
Fine, but make it quick...
I have a busy day tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like for you to listen to this song I wrote.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: One you wrote...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
It's for an event that—

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: I refuse.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Why are you even asking? You chose to not take the same path as me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I had a feeling you'd say that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But I still want you to listen to it.
As a creator, I'd like to hear what you have to say about it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right now, I...
We're getting ready to put on an incredibly important event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
An event that means everything to us.
If it doesn't go well, our dream may never come true.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I've been asked to come up with the songs for it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's why I need to produce some good ones no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So, please!
Tell me what you think! Anything will do!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: I've already heard it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: It's the one you've been playing on your speakers, no? You could hear it throughout the whole house. Did you think I wouldn't notice?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh...
I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, what did you think...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: It's not worthy of assessment...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Your song lacks pride...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: That is all.
se_walk_men_006_1

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, Dad...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It lacked pride...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He probably thinks I'm pathetic to ask for his advice after turning my back on his tutelage...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Perhaps...
My lack of confidence was at the forefront and this song has just become an expression of that.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, I don't have time to be feeling down.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have to keep looking for a way to produce that energy and atmosphere...)
